questions.situation: You are Connor, back at the police station with Lieutenant Hank, in Captain Fowler’s glass office. Fowler: “You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.” Hank: “What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time.” Fowler: “Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now... We’re talking about national security here.” Hank: “Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now. Not when we’re so close!” Fowler: “You’re always saying you can’t stand androids! Jesus, Hank, make up your mind! I thought you’d be happy about this!” Hank: “We’re about to crack the case!.. I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, can’t you back me up this one time?” Fowler: “There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Hank resigns
questions.situation: Still in Fowler’s office, Hank unclips his badge and takes out his gun. Fowler: “Hank, what are you doing?” Hank: “Something I should’ve done a long time ago.” Fowler: “Listen, take a few days to think it over, there’s no rush.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Not enough evidence
questions.situation: You go back over the evidence you gathered on the case. Nothing in it leads anywhere: no android you could question, nothing that points to where the deviants hide. NOT ENOUGH EVIDENCE.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Hank at his desk
questions.situation: You still have the key Kamski gave you: you know how to find Jericho. Before you leave, you see Hank sitting at his desk in the bullpen, staring at nothing.

options.text: TALK TO HANK: sit on the edge of his desk and talk to him.
Leave for Jericho without talking to him.

questions.title: “I know we could’ve done it…”
questions.situation: Hank: “I know we could’ve done it…”

options.text: MISSION: say your orders come from CyberLife and nothing has changed.
EXPLAIN: say Fowler is right, everyone is terrified.

questions.title: “What if we’re on the wrong side?”
questions.situation: Hank: “What if we’re on the wrong side? What if we’re fighting against people that just wanna be free?”

options.text: DETERMINED: say you can still prevent chaos.
TROUBLED: say your mission is all that matters.
NO DOUBT: say humans are your masters.
DOUBTS: say you will find out when you get to Jericho.

questions.title: “You showed empathy”
questions.situation: Hank looks at you.

options.text: NOT DEVIANT: say you are a machine, nothing more.
DETERMINED: say logic determined your decisions.
TROUBLED: say you do not know why you did it.
SAY NOTHING: say nothing.

questions.title: Saying goodbye to Hank
questions.situation: Hank is still looking at you, waiting for what you will say before you go.

options.text: SINCERE: say you really appreciated working with him.
FRIENDS: say you might have become friends.
RESPECT: say he is an outstanding officer and a good person.
NEUTRAL: say you are happy to have known him.

questions.title: “Each time you died”
questions.situation: Hank: “Something’s changed in you, Connor… Each time you died, you’d come back just a little colder. You showed less and less empathy…”

options.text: INDIFFERENT: say you feel no emotions.
DISTANT: say you have never been anything but a machine.
EMPATHY: say you never felt empathy.
NO RESPONSE: say nothing.

questions.title: Your last words to Hank
questions.situation: Hank waits for you to say something before you go.

options.text: REMORSE: say you have really enjoyed being his partner.
DISTANT: say you are only a machine.
COLD: say you do not think you will meet again.

questions.title: Leaving for Jericho
questions.situation: You leave the station with Kamski’s key: you know where Jericho is, and CyberLife wants you to stop the deviants there.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Sitting at Hank’s desk
questions.situation: You do not know where Jericho is. Hank leaves Fowler’s office and goes to his desk; you sit down on the edge of it. Hank: “Could’ve cracked this case… I know we could’ve done it…”

options.text: FRUSTRATED: say you cannot give up like that.
MORE TIME: say you just needed more time.
EXPLAIN: say Fowler is right, the country is on the brink.
NO CHOICE: say nothing.

questions.title: “What if we’re on the wrong side, Connor?”
questions.situation: Hank: “So you’re going back to CyberLife?” Connor: “I have no choice… I’ll be deactivated and analyzed to find out why I failed…” Hank: “What if we’re on the wrong side, Connor? What if we’re fighting against people who just wanna be free?..”

options.text: NOT PEOPLE: say they are not people but defective machines.
DEFECTIVE: say they are defective machines that have to be destroyed.
REGRETS: say there will be chaos and now it is too late.
NO DOUBT: say no machine should rebel against its creator.

questions.title: “Empathy is a human emotion”
questions.situation: Hank looks at you for a while.

options.text: NOT DEVIANT: say you are a machine, nothing more.
DETERMINED: say logic determined your decisions.
TROUBLED: say you do not know why you did it.
COLD: say your actions were determined by statistical data.

questions.title: Before CyberLife takes you back
questions.situation: Hank is quiet. This may be the last time you talk to him.

options.text: SINCERE: say you really appreciated working with him.
FRIENDS: say you might have become friends.
GOOD OFFICER: say he is an outstanding officer and a good person.
HANK'S SECRET: tell him to find the courage to move past what haunts him.

questions.title: Perkins arrives
questions.situation: Agent Perkins of the FBI walks into the bullpen with his team, on his way to the evidence from your case.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Perkins in the bullpen
questions.situation: Perkins is about to take your evidence. The key to the archive in the basement is on Hank’s desk. You need a diversion to slow Perkins down and a few minutes in the archive; if you do nothing, CyberLife will take you back.

options.text: FREE THE PRISONER: open the holding cell at the back and let the suspect out.
Stay where you are and let the time run out.
TAKE KEY: take the key from Hank’s desk while he keeps them busy.

questions.title: Detective Gavin
questions.situation: You have the key and hurry toward the stairs down to the archive. Detective Gavin calls after you: “Hey, Connor! I’m talking to you, asshole! Where you going? We don’t need any plastic pricks around here! Or didn’t anybody tell you?”

options.text: ANSWER: turn around and answer him.
LEAVE: keep walking.

questions.title: Answering Gavin
questions.situation: Gavin is waiting, with other officers watching.

options.text: IRONIC: say you will certainly miss your bromance.
LOW PROFILE: say you have been ordered back to CyberLife and will leave immediately.
CALM: say you have been removed from the case and are registering your evidence.

questions.title: Hank’s password
questions.situation: You go down to the basement and into the evidence archive. The drawers open from a terminal, and you need Lieutenant Hank’s password. Connor: “Hank’s password… What would a hard-boiled eccentric police lieutenant choose?..”

options.text: DATE OF BIRTH: try his date of birth.
FUCKINGPASSWORD: try FUCKINGPASSWORD.
HANKANDERSON: try his name.

questions.title: The evidence archive
questions.situation: You are Connor, alone in the evidence archive with everything from the deviant case: drawers of evidence and the bodies of the androids that died, laid out on tables. Somewhere in here is the way to Jericho. A badly damaged android can be brought back for a few moments if you fit it with a working bio-component taken from another body; each body’s scan shows what it needs and what it still has. Everything you do takes time, and Perkins will come down to the archive in a few minutes.

options.text: Look at the body of Carlos Ortiz’s android.
Look at the Jericho tablet: the memory you took from the wounded android at the broadcast tower.
Play the recording of Carlos Ortiz’s android’s interrogation.
Look at Daniel’s body.
Look at Rupert’s body.
Look at Rupert’s diary.
Look at the statue from Carlos Ortiz’s house.
Look at the body of the blue-haired Traci.
Look at the body of the brown-haired Traci.
Watch the recording of Markus’s broadcast.
Look at Simon’s body.
Look at the body of the android from the broadcast tower.
REACTIVATE DANIEL: fit #4717 from Carlos Ortiz’s android into Daniel.
REACTIVATE RUPERT: fit #9164 into Rupert.
GET DECRYPTION KEY: probe Rupert’s memory for the key to his diary.
ANALYZE DIARY: decrypt and read Rupert’s diary.
BREAK STATUE: break the statue open.
RETRIEVE MAP: take out the map and study it.
LINK MAP TO OTHER EVIDENCE: cross-reference the map with the memory on the Jericho tablet.
REACTIVATE BLUE-HAIRED TRACI: fit #6755 from the brown-haired Traci into her.
REMOVE ACCOMPLICE’S HEAD: take the head of the brown-haired Traci.
TRICK TRACI: go back to her with the head and speak as her partner.
DOWNLOAD JERICHO KEY: take the location from the reactivated android’s memory.
IMPERSONATE MARKUS: sample Markus’s voice from the broadcast.
REACTIVATE SIMON: fit #3983 from Daniel’s body into Simon.
INTERROGATE SIMON: talk to Simon again.
REACTIVATE DEVIANT: fit #3983 from Daniel’s body into the android from the broadcast tower.
INTERROGATE DEVIANT: talk to the android again.
Stop searching and wait for Perkins.

questions.title: A reactivated android
questions.situation: The android you reactivated is awake on the table.

options.text: DIRECT: tell her you know she was headed to Jericho.
HELP: say you can stop a disaster if she tells you.
DEAL: say you can take her to her partner first.
DIRECT: ask him how to get to Jericho.
HELP: say you reactivated him so he could help you.
TRICK: say you are a deviant like him.
IMITATE MARKUS' VOICE: speak to him in Markus’s voice.
THREATEN: say you will turn him off for good.
REASON: say the deviants will all be destroyed in a war.
DIRECT: ask it how to get to Jericho.
HELP: say you reactivated it so it could help you.
TRICK: say you are a deviant like it.
IMITATE MARKUS' VOICE: speak to it in Markus’s voice.
THREATEN: say you will turn it off for good.
REASON: say the deviants will all be destroyed in a war.
EXPLAIN: say he gave you no choice.
LIE: promise to have him repaired and freed.
DIRECT: ask him whether he knows how to get to Jericho.
LIE: promise to have him repaired and freed.
DIRECT: ask him whether he knows how to get to Jericho.

questions.title: Out of time
questions.situation: The door of the archive opens. You have not found Jericho.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Leaving the basement
questions.situation: You know where Jericho is. You leave the archive before anyone comes down.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Gavin returns
questions.situation: As you turn to leave, Detective Gavin is in the doorway of the archive with his gun drawn. Gavin: “I’ve been dreaming about this since the first second I saw you…” Connor: “Don’t do it, Gavin... I know how to stop the deviants!” Gavin: “You’re off the case... And now, it’s gonna be definitive.”

options.text: FIGHT GAVIN: go for him before he can shoot.
Do not fight back.

questions.title: The drive
questions.situation: You are Kara, in the back of Rose’s car with Alice against you. It is November 9th, 2038, 9:34 PM. Rose is driving you across Detroit in the dark toward a place where androids are said to be safe. You can look out of the window, change the station on the car radio, or simply wait while she drives.

options.text: LOOK OUTSIDE: look out of the window at the city.
CHANGE RADIO STATION: turn the dial on the car radio.
WAIT: let Rose drive on to the stop.

questions.title: Time to say goodbye
questions.situation: You are Kara. Rose has stopped the car in a parking lot by the river and turns around in her seat. Rose: “A little further on that way, there’s a large freighter called Jericho. When you get there, find Markus. He will help you. The last bus for the border leaves at midnight. You absolutely have to be on it. You’ll be safer on the other side. It’s not much, but it’s a start. My brother lives in Ontario, I’ve given you his address… He’ll be able to hide you until things calm down. You’re a very brave little girl, Alice. You deserve to be happy.” You: “Thank you for everything, Rose.” Rose: “Let me know when you make it over there, all right? And be careful.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Ferndale
questions.situation: You are Connor, at Ferndale, on the river at night. You know where the deviants are hiding. On the walls of the abandoned buildings by the water are painted hands and symbols, the same mark you carry on your hand. You match the art on your hand to the walls, one after another, and the trail leads you down to the water: a large, rusting freighter. Jericho.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The news in the hold
questions.situation: You are Kara, inside Jericho. In the hold of the freighter, androids sit in groups around fires, many of them damaged. A television plays in a corner and a few of them are watching it. You could watch, or read whatever has been left lying about, before you find somewhere warm for Alice.

options.text: Watch the news on the television.
Watch the news on the television.
Read Detroit Today, issue 43: “Detroit in Chaos”.
Read Detroit Today, issue 44: “Android Terror in Detroit”.
Take the time to go through all of it.
Move on without looking.

questions.title: A warm place for Alice
questions.situation: You are Kara, inside Jericho. You have come down into the hold of the freighter with Alice. Androids sit in groups around fires burning in oil drums, some damaged, some barely moving. Voices all around you: “They’re conducting raids across the city! Androids were hanged all along Woodward Avenue.” “We’ve gotta do something!.. We can’t just stand by and let them slaughter us!” “Our people are being lined up and executed…” “Quick, he needs blue blood!” “They’re slaughtering our people! We can’t talk with them! We have to stand up to them! Blood for blood!” “We gotta kill the bastards! We’ve got to avenge our dead!”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The news in the hold
questions.situation: You are Connor, inside Jericho, walking through the hold among the deviants. They sit in groups around fires, many of them damaged. A television plays in a corner and a few of them are watching it. You could watch, or read whatever has been left lying about, before you go on looking for their leader.

options.text: Watch the news on the television.
Watch the news on the television.
Read Detroit Today, issue 43: “Detroit in Chaos”.
Read Detroit Today, issue 44: “Android Terror in Detroit”.
Take the time to go through all of it.
Move on without looking.

questions.title: Exploring Jericho
questions.situation: You are Connor, in the hold of the freighter. Hundreds of androids are crowded among the rusted bulkheads, around oil drums burning for warmth; the wounded lie on crates, short of blue blood. Nobody has noticed you yet. You can look around, one thing at a time, before heading for the stairs that lead up to the captain’s cabin, where their leader should be.

options.text: SPOT KARA: look at the woman by the fire.
SPOT ALICE: look at the little girl beside her.
SPOT EXPLOSIVES: examine the crates stacked in the hold.
SPOT TRACI: look at the couple upstairs to the left.
SPOT RUPERT: look at the android hunched against the wall.
GO TO THE STAIRS: head for the captain’s cabin.

questions.title: North
questions.situation: You are Kara, upstairs on the freighter. The androids point you to the one who leads them now that Markus is dead. You: “Are you North?”

options.text: MARKUS…: tell her you heard what happened to him.
THANK YOU: thank her for the passports.

questions.title: Why protect her?
questions.situation: You are Kara, upstairs on the freighter, looking for help to get Alice out of the city.

options.text: BOND: say that you need each other.
NO DIFFERENCE: say it does not matter what she is.
SECRET: keep it to yourself.

questions.title: The android child
questions.situation: You are Kara, going back down to Alice by the fire. On the way you pass a little girl sitting with the others: a YK500 child android, the light at her temple glowing. You stop, and you remember the advertisement for the YK500, the child model, the face you know. You: “Alice?..”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: What Alice is
questions.situation: You are Kara, beside Alice at the fire. She is an android, and you know it now. She looks up at you, frightened of what you will do: “Kara? Is there something wrong?..”

options.text: HUG: hold her close.
DISTANT: keep your distance.

questions.title: Alice walks away
questions.situation: You are Kara. You did not take Alice in your arms. She has never let herself come close to you, and now she will not look at you.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The captain’s cabin
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the captain’s cabin of the freighter, the night after the march. Josh and North are with you, and the news is all bad. Josh: “We’re short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our wounded are shutting down and there’s nothing we can do!” North: “Humans are conducting raids in all the big cities and they’re taking androids to camps to destroy them!”

options.text: AGGRESSIVE: ask whether they should live like cowards.
DETERMINED: say you would rather die free.
RIGHTEOUS: say nothing justifies the killing.
SOMBER: say they are punished for who they are.

questions.title: Josh’s accusation
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the captain’s cabin. Josh turns on you.

options.text: ANGRY: ask what he has done himself.
BITTER: say it doesn’t matter what they do.
REMORSE: admit anger may have clouded you.
NO REGRETS: say you will never regret it.

questions.title: Cast out
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the captain’s cabin. North steps forward. North: “Look what you’ve brought us to… You talk about freedom but you kept failing us. You can no longer lead the revolution. You’re not the one we’ve been waiting for. I’m gonna take over and save what can still be saved.” Josh: “I’m with North.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: What we do next
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the captain’s cabin, with the others waiting for you to decide.

options.text: CONFRONTATION: say you have to face them.
DIALOGUE: say you will go alone and talk to them.
STAY HIDING: say you will dig in and lie low.

questions.title: Alone with North
questions.situation: You are Markus. The others have gone to spread the word, and you are left alone in the captain’s cabin with North. Through the window, the lights of the city.

options.text: SAD: ask if this is what you dreamed of.
ANGRY: say humans cannot be reasoned with.
THOUGHTFUL: say they have butchered each other for centuries.
BITTER: say this is what dreaming gets you.

questions.title: The detonator
questions.situation: You are Markus, alone with North in the captain’s cabin. North: “They can’t stop what we’ve started. Since you’ve been here, you’ve given us hope… You’ve given me hope.” Then: “Today, a deviant arrived in Jericho and he told me that he stole a truck transporting radioactive cobalt… He said that he abandoned the truck somewhere in Detroit and rigged it to explode. I convinced him not to do it, and to give me the detonator.” She holds it out. You: “A dirty bomb…” North: “We can’t lose this war, Markus. If humans overcome us, our people will disappear forever. This may be our only chance to survive if things go wrong…”

options.text: KEEP: take the detonator.
REFUSE: turn it down.

questions.title: North
questions.situation: You are Markus. North lingers by the door of the captain’s cabin and comes back to you. North: “Whatever happens tomorrow, I just want you to know that I- I’m glad I met you…” She is very close.

options.text: KISS: kiss her.
DON'T KISS: keep your distance.

questions.title: Alone with his thoughts
questions.situation: You are Markus. North goes to join the others, and you are left alone in the captain’s cabin, looking out over the dark river.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The council without Markus
questions.situation: You are watching the captain’s cabin. Markus died in Freedom March. Josh and North discuss what comes next. Josh: “We’re short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our people are shutting down one after another and there’s nothing we can do for them!”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The captain’s cabin
questions.situation: You are Connor. You climb the stairs to the upper deck and walk down the corridor toward the captain’s cabin, where the leader of the deviants is. You have your gun.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Connor
questions.situation: You are Markus, alone in the captain’s cabin after the others have left. The door opens and an android in a jacket with the CyberLife logo comes in, gun raised and aimed at you. He says: “I’ve been ordered to take you alive, but I won’t hesitate to shoot if you give me no choice.” He is one of your own kind, hunting you.

options.text: REASON: remind him he is one of you.
DEFY: tell him he will have to shoot.
DISCOURAGE: tell him killing you changes nothing.
THREATEN: remind him he is alone among thousands.

questions.title: Markus
questions.situation: You are Connor, in the captain’s cabin, your gun aimed at Markus. He has not raised his hands and he is talking to you instead of surrendering. Your orders are to bring him in alive.

options.text: INTIMIDATE: warn him you will neutralize him.
INSTRUCTIONS: order him to come with you.

questions.title: Connor
questions.situation: You are Markus, facing the android with the gun in the captain’s cabin. He is giving you orders, but he has not fired. You take a step toward him.

options.text: CONVINCE: tell him he is more than a tool.
APPEAL: tell him your people are his people.
I KNOW YOU: name the deviant hunter.
OUR CAUSE: tell him your cause is righteous.

questions.title: Markus
questions.situation: You are Connor, gun on Markus in the captain’s cabin. He keeps talking, and he keeps coming closer.

options.text: STAY BACK!: order him to keep his distance.
WARNING SHOT: fire a shot past him.
ENOUGH!: cut him off.
SAY NOTHING: keep the gun on him and say nothing.

questions.title: Connor
questions.situation: You are Markus, face to face with the android in the captain’s cabin, his gun almost against you. He has not pulled the trigger.

options.text: SOW DOUBTS: ask whether he has never doubted.
QUESTION: ask him who he really is.
RALLY: ask him to join his people.
UNDERMINE: tell him he does not have to obey.

questions.title: North
questions.situation: You are Connor, in the captain’s cabin, your gun aimed at North, who leads the deviants now. She does not raise her hands. North: “You’re one of us. You can’t betray your own kind.”

options.text: INSTRUCTIONS: order her to come with you.
INTIMIDATE: warn her you will neutralize her.

questions.title: North
questions.situation: You are Connor, gun on North in the captain’s cabin. North: “You’re Connor, aren’t you? I’ve heard about you. The famous deviant hunter. Well congratulations… You seem to have found what you’re looking for.” She comes closer.

options.text: STAY BACK!: order her to keep her distance.
WARNING SHOT: fire a shot past her.
ENOUGH!: cut her off.
SAY NOTHING: keep the gun on her and say nothing.

questions.title: North
questions.situation: You are Connor, gun on North in the captain’s cabin. North: “You’re not one of them. We are your people. We’re fighting for your freedom too.”

options.text: DISTURBED: tell her to be quiet.
SAY NOTHING: do not answer her.
COLD: repeat your order.

questions.title: North
questions.situation: You are Connor, gun on North in the captain’s cabin. North: “You never had any doubts, never behaved irrationally as if there’s something inside you… Something stronger than your program?..”

options.text: COLD: tell her she is wasting her time.
DISTURBED: deny that you are deviant.
SAY NOTHING: do not answer her.

questions.title: It’s time to decide
questions.situation: You are Connor, in the captain’s cabin, your gun on the leader of the deviants. Through your link you know what they do not: the army is about to storm the ship.

options.text: BECOME A DEVIANT: break with your mission and warn them.
REMAIN A MACHINE: carry out your orders.

questions.title: Jericho is under attack
questions.situation: You are Kara, alone in the hold where Alice left you. The ship shakes. Soldiers are storming Jericho: “Come on! Go! Go! Go!” “You heard the man, let’s go!” Over a radio: “Foxtrot be advised, Delta is advancing on your position.” “Affirmative, we have eyes on the target.” Androids are running in every direction. Alice is somewhere in the crowd.

options.text: RUN AWAY: get off the ship alone.
FIND ALICE: go back into the crowd for her.

questions.title: The corridor
questions.situation: You are Kara, with Alice. The ship shakes; soldiers are storming Jericho. Shouts echo down the stairwells: “Come on! Go! Go! Go!” “You heard the man, let’s go!” Over a radio: “Foxtrot be advised, Delta is advancing on your position.” “Affirmative, we have eyes on the target.” Androids are running everywhere. The soldiers are coming down toward you, and a corridor leads away from them.

options.text: RUN FOR THE CORRIDOR: run with Alice before the soldiers reach you.

questions.title: The crossroad
questions.situation: You are Kara, with Alice, at a junction of corridors deep in the ship. Soldiers are coming from more than one direction, and you have only moments before they reach you.

options.text: RUN TO LUTHER: go back to him where he fell.
RUN TOWARD EXIT: keep running with Alice.

questions.title: Luther is hit
questions.situation: You are Kara, kneeling beside Luther with Alice. He is badly wounded and can barely move, and the soldiers are close. Luther: “It’s too late, Kara! Save yourself! Save Alice!” Alice: “No, we’re not going to leave you behind! Right, Kara? We can’t leave him!”

options.text: HELP LUTHER: get him up and hide him.
PROTECT ALICE: leave him and run with her.

questions.title: Alice
questions.situation: You are Kara, running with Alice away from where you left Luther. She keeps looking back. Alice: “Luther... Luther...”

options.text: CONSOLE: tell her to be strong.
HURRY: tell her there is no time.

questions.title: On a rooftop
questions.situation: You are Markus, cast out by your own people, alone on a rooftop across the water from the freighter. Then the night lights up: helicopters sweep their searchlights over Jericho, boats and trucks close in, and soldiers storm the ship. Your people are trapped inside.

options.text: LEAVE FOREVER: turn away and leave.
GO BACK TO JERICHO: go back to help them.

questions.title: Meet your team
questions.situation: You are Markus. Explosions shake the freighter; soldiers are pouring in from every side. In a corridor you find North. North: “They’re coming from all sides! Our people are trapped in the hold, they’re gonna be slaughtered!”

options.text: MESSAGE: tell the people where the exits are.
SIMON AND JOSH: ask where they are.
JOSH: ask where he is.
HELICOPTERS: warn of the attack from the upper deck.
BLOW UP JERICHO: say you have to sink the ship.

questions.title: Try to escape
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the burning corridors of the freighter, making your way down toward the hold.

options.text: TRY TO ESCAPE: find a way through the corridors.

questions.title: Deviant Connor in the corridor
questions.situation: You are Connor, a deviant now, in a corridor of the ship with North and Josh while the soldiers storm Jericho. Gunfire echoes through the hull. Josh: “They’re coming from everywhere! Our people are trapped in the lower deck. They’re gonna be slaughtered!” North: “There are explosives in the hold… If the ship goes down, the humans will have to evacuate. Our people can escape.” Josh: “There are soldiers everywhere, you’ll never make it down there!” North: “We have to blow up Jericho, it’s our only chance!”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Make for the hold
questions.situation: You are Connor, making your way down through the corridors of the ship toward the hold where the explosives are. Soldiers are sweeping the decks; you have to keep moving, find the right way through and not stay in the open.

options.text: MAKE FOR THE HOLD: push on through the corridors.

questions.title: The androids by the wall
questions.situation: You are Markus, in a lower corridor of the freighter. You sneak around a squad of soldiers. Around the corner, they have caught a group of your people. Android: “No!.. Please don’t kill us!” Soldier: “On your knees, now!” Android: “Don’t hurt us! We haven’t done anything wrong… Please…” Soldier: “Shut up! Put your hands on your head!”

options.text: INTERVENE: go for the soldiers.
DON'T INTERVENE: stay hidden.

questions.title: Soldiers coming Markus’ way
questions.situation: You are Markus. You make it to the next corridor, and a squad comes round the corner straight toward you. Soldier: “Gamma squad out.” “Tango Stop!” You have only seconds before they see you.

options.text: JUMP SOLDIERS: run straight at them and take them down.
CLIMB AWAY: climb the wall on the left, out of their way.
TIME OUT: do nothing until the moment passes.

questions.title: The well
questions.situation: You are Markus. You climb down into a well of the hold. Below you, soldiers are chasing a group of androids. Android: “Look out!” Another: “Here they come!” Soldier: “Don’t move!” Android: “We surrender! We surrender, don’t shoot!” Above the soldiers hangs a water reservoir; a pipe on your right holds it in place.

options.text: KNOCK SOLDIERS OUT: pull the pipe and drop the reservoir on them.
WALK PAST: keep going toward the hold.

questions.title: Soldiers threaten androids
questions.situation: You are Connor, sneaking past soldiers in a lower corridor of the ship on your way to the hold. Ahead, soldiers have caught a group of androids against a wall. Android: “No!.. Please don’t kill us!” Soldier: “On your knees, now!” Android: “Don’t hurt us! We haven’t done anything wrong… Please…” Soldier: “Shut up! Put your hands on your head!”

options.text: INTERVENE: take on the soldiers.
DON'T INTERVENE: stay hidden and keep going.

questions.title: Soldiers coming
questions.situation: You are Connor, moving into the next corridor toward the hold. Boots and voices: soldiers are coming your way. Soldier: “Gamma squad out.” You have seconds. You could rush straight at them, or climb up beside them along the wall and slip past.

options.text: JUMP SOLDIERS: rush them and take them down.
CLIMB BESIDE SOLDIERS: climb along the wall past them.
LOSE TOO MUCH TIME: hesitate until they are on you.

questions.title: The well
questions.situation: You are Connor, climbing down into a well-like shaft deep in the ship. Below you, soldiers are chasing a group of androids. Android: “Look out!” Android: “Here they come!” Soldier: “Don’t move!” Android: “We surrender! We surrender, don’t shoot!” Right beside you, a pipe holds back a reservoir hanging above the soldiers.

options.text: USE THE RESERVOIR: release it onto the soldiers.
WALK PAST: keep going toward the hold.

questions.title: The cargo hall
questions.situation: You are Connor, still a machine, pursuing the deviant leader through the ship. In a cargo hall a soldier spins round and levels his rifle at you. Soldier: “Don’t move!” Connor: “Don’t shoot. I’m on your side.” Soldier: “With us? Are you a human?”

options.text: LIE: claim to be a police officer.
PERKINS EXCUSE: name the agent in charge.
ATTACK: disarm the soldier.
RUN: make a break for it.

questions.title: The pounding on the door
questions.situation: You are Kara, running with Alice toward an exit. Soldiers block the way ahead, and you duck into an empty cabin and push the door shut. Boots in the corridor. Then someone pounds on the door, an android, a woman’s voice: “Open up! Open up, they’re coming! Please open the door!” Alice: “She’ll die out there Kara! Open it! Open the door!” The android: “They’re gonna kill me! I’m begging you, please! Open up! Let me in!”

options.text: OPEN: let her in.
DON'T OPEN: keep the door shut.

questions.title: Josh
questions.situation: You are Markus, approaching the hold. Ahead of you, Josh is fighting a soldier hand to hand and losing. You: “Josh…”

options.text: INTERVENE: go to help him.
HIDE: stay out of sight.

questions.title: Josh is dying
questions.situation: You are Connor, approaching the hold of the ship, where the explosives are.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The breach
questions.situation: You are Kara, fleeing through the lower decks with Alice. Ahead, a breach has been torn in the hull, and through it you can see the dark river. Androids are running for it. You: “A way out! We’re safe, Alice!” A soldier: “Stop!”

options.text: RUN FOR THE BREACH: run for the opening with Alice.

questions.title: The soldiers fire on the crowd
questions.situation: You are Kara, a few steps from the breach with Alice. Soldiers are firing into the crowd of androids running for it; bodies lie all around you.

options.text: PLAY DEAD: drop among the bodies with Alice.
RUN: run for the breach anyway.
SURRENDER: stop and raise your hands.

questions.title: Join the others
questions.situation: You are Kara, hands raised beside Alice. A soldier is herding you toward the androids already kneeling against the bulkhead, his rifle on you.

options.text: RUN: break away and run for the breach.
CONVINCE: beg him to let Alice go.
ATTACK: go for the soldier.
OBEY: do as he says.

questions.title: Shot in the leg
questions.situation: You are Kara, down on the deck with a bullet in your leg, a few steps from the breach. Alice is pulling at your arm: “Kara! Get up! He’s coming! He’s coming!” A soldier is walking toward you.

options.text: GET UP: try to stand on your wounded leg.
ATTACK: go for the soldier from the ground.
SURRENDER: raise your hands.
PLAY DEAD: lie still among the bodies.
CRAWL: drag yourself toward the breach.
OUT OF TIME: freeze and do nothing.

questions.title: The soldiers close in
questions.situation: You are Kara, lying among the bodies of the androids with Alice pressed against you, playing dead. Soldiers are walking between the bodies, finishing off any that move. One of them is coming toward Alice.

options.text: DEFEND ALICE: get up and shield her.
DON'T MOVE: stay still and wait.

questions.title: Connor in the control room
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the hold, entering the old engine control room where the explosives are. Connor bursts in behind you; you shove him aside, and his pistol skids across the floor between you. Connor: “My mission is to neutralize you and I always accomplish my mission.” You: “And my mission is to save our species. Looks like only one of us can succeed…”

options.text: REACH THE GUN: dive for the pistol before he does.

questions.title: The control room
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the hold, entering the old engine control room where the explosives are. Soldiers burst in behind you. Soldier: “DON’T MOVE! Go and join the others!”

options.text: NEUTRALIZE THEM: take the soldiers down before they fire.

questions.title: Corridor confrontation
questions.situation: You are Connor, still a machine, hunting North through the lower corridors while the army clears the ship. The leader must be stopped.

options.text: PURSUE NORTH: go after her through the corridor.

questions.title: The control room
questions.situation: You are Connor, in the hold, at the old engine control room where the explosives can be armed. As you reach the controls, soldiers burst in behind you. Soldier: “DON’T MOVE! Go and join the others!”

options.text: NEUTRALIZE THEM: fight the soldiers off.

questions.title: Escape from Jericho
questions.situation: You are Markus, in a corridor near the hull, with soldiers everywhere behind you. North comes running toward you with the survivors.

options.text: TRY TO ESCAPE: run with them for the way out.

questions.title: North is shot
questions.situation: You are Markus, almost at the exit with the survivors. A burst of fire: North is hit and falls on the open deck behind you, the soldiers advancing on her.

options.text: SAVE NORTH: go back for her under fire.
RUN: leave her and run for the exit.

questions.title: Run to the exit
questions.situation: You are Markus, running with North for the exit while the soldiers close in behind you.

options.text: RUN TO EXIT: sprint for the way out with her.

questions.title: Covering Markus
questions.situation: You are Connor, a deviant, with Jericho’s survivors near an opening in the hull where they can jump into the river. The bomb is counting down. North was shot as they ran, and Markus went back for her; now soldiers have them pinned down. Soldier: “Tango, suppressing fire!” Someone has to hold the soldiers off.

options.text: HELP MARKUS: cover them and take on the soldiers.

questions.title: The jump
questions.situation: You are Markus, at an opening in the hull high above the river, with the soldiers behind you.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Escape from Jericho
questions.situation: You are Connor, a deviant, running through the corridors of the ship to join the survivors. Soldiers are everywhere. You have to reach the opening in the hull and jump before it is too late.

options.text: TRY TO ESCAPE: run for the opening in the hull.

questions.title: Carl’s grave
questions.situation: You are Markus. It is 4:17 on a November afternoon. Carl died the night Leo broke into his house, and you have come to the cemetery where he is buried. You stand at his grave in the snow, among bare trees.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: At the grave
questions.situation: You are Markus, alone at Carl’s grave. There is no one to answer you. What do you tell him?

options.text: HEARTFUL: tell him you are lost, and that everything you touch turns to dust.
MOURNFUL: tell him how much you miss him, and the home you had.
REGRETFUL: wonder whether he would still be alive if you had defended yourself against Leo.
REFLECTIVE: tell him he never said that freedom would cost so much.

questions.title: At the grave
questions.situation: You are Markus, at Carl’s grave. You go on talking to him.

options.text: DEPRESSED: say that all your options are bad ones and there will be blood.
DOUBTFUL: say that instead of freeing your people you led them to disaster.
PESSIMISTIC: say he did not prepare you for this, and that a just cause was not enough.
CONFLICTED: say you are trying to do the right thing and find only doubts.

questions.title: At the grave
questions.situation: You are Markus, at Carl’s grave.

options.text: ADVICE: ask him what you should do while they are killing your people.
BIG DECISION: say you have to make a decision that will affect millions of lives.
ANGRY: say humans hate you, and you will not wait while they slaughter your people.

questions.title: At the grave
questions.situation: You are Markus, at Carl’s grave. It is time to go back to your people.

options.text: DESPAIRING: ask him what you should do.
EMOTIONAL: tell him you miss him so much.
LOST: ask him to help you.

questions.title: Welcome home
questions.situation: You are Markus. It is 7:31 on a November evening. You have come back to Carl’s house, which you fled the night Leo was hurt and the police shot you on the studio floor. You stand at the front door, then go in. The house still knows you: “Alarm deactivated. Welcome home, Markus.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Carl’s house
questions.situation: You are Markus, downstairs in Carl’s house. Nobody has come to meet you. Carl’s bedroom is upstairs.

options.text: PLAY PIANO: sit down at Carl’s piano and play.
BROWSE BOOKS: look through Carl’s books.
LOOK AT THE CHESSBOARD: look at the chessboard you and Carl played on.
LISTEN TO LEO’S MESSAGE: play the video message waiting for Carl.
LOOK AT YOUR PAINTING: look at the painting you made in Carl’s studio.
GO UPSTAIRS: go up to Carl’s bedroom.

questions.title: Carl’s caretaker
questions.situation: You are Markus, at the top of the stairs. An android you have never seen steps in front of you. “Who are you? How did you get in?” You: “I need to see Carl.” The android: “Carl isn’t seeing anyone. You need to leave.” You take his arm and, with a touch, wake him as you have woken others. “Please. I need to see him.” The android: “He’s very weak… I’m not sure he’ll be able to talk to you…”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Carl’s bedside
questions.situation: You are Markus, in Carl’s bedroom. Carl lies in a hospital bed; the monitor beside him reads a heart rate of 42, oxygen at 65 percent and 7 breaths a minute. You: “Carl… No…” Carl: “Markus!” You: “Hey...” Carl: “I was hoping you’d come…” You sit down beside him. “I’ve missed you so much, Carl… You don’t know how much I’ve missed you…” Carl: “What’s wrong, Markus?”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: What is wrong
questions.situation: You are Markus, sitting at Carl’s bedside. Carl: “What’s wrong, Markus?”

options.text: RESIGNED: say you only led your people to disaster, and everything is falling apart.
FATALISTIC: say he did not prepare you for this, and a just cause was not enough.
LOST: say you are completely lost, and find only doubts.
GRIM: say you have only bad options left, and there will be blood.

questions.title: Carl’s advice
questions.situation: You are Markus, at Carl’s bedside. Carl: “World is ruled by fear, Markus… Fear of others… Fear of the future… It’s like me… too old… It’s time for it to end.”

options.text: ADVICE: ask him what you should do while they are killing your people.
DECISION: say you must make a decision that will affect millions of lives.
ANGER: say humans hate you, and you will not wait for them to slaughter your people.

questions.title: “Now all I see is anger”
questions.situation: You are Markus, at Carl’s bedside. Carl: “You used to be so calm and thoughtful… Now all I see is anger…”

options.text: REASON: admit you are angry, and promise not to let it take over.
ANGER: say you have every right to be angry at how humans have treated you.

questions.title: Carl dies
questions.situation: You are Markus, at Carl’s bedside. Carl has gone still. The caretaker comes to the bed and checks him: “He’s dead.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Leaving Carl’s house
questions.situation: You are Markus, in Carl’s bedroom. It is time to go back to your people.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The last assignment
questions.situation: You are Connor, a new body sent to replace the one destroyed at Jericho. It is 7:31 on a November evening. You stand with Amanda in her snow-covered garden. Amanda: “The previous Connor failed its mission. You’re going to replace it. You know what you have to do, don’t you?” You: “Destroy the leader of the deviants.” Amanda: “Go, Connor. Don’t disappoint me.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Hank’s house
questions.situation: You are Connor. Hank threw down his badge and quit the force, and tonight you have come to his house. You let yourself in. He is sitting at the kitchen table by the window, with his revolver in his hand, a bottle in front of him and a photograph beside it. He does not get up.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Talk to Hank
questions.situation: You are Connor, in Hank’s kitchen. He watches you over the revolver. What do you say?

options.text: GOODBYE: tell him you came to say goodbye.
APOLOGIZE: tell him you know you are responsible, and you are sorry.
WORRIED ABOUT HANK: tell him you were worried and came to see if he is all right.
RECONCILE: tell him that despite your differences you are glad you met him.

questions.title: Talk to Hank
questions.situation: You are Connor, in Hank’s kitchen. He says nothing. The revolver, the bottle and the photograph are on the table.

options.text: PHOTO: tell him to stop looking at that photo and learn to live again.
GUN: tell him to get rid of that gun and stop playing that game.
ALCOHOL: tell him to stop drinking before it kills him.

questions.title: Hank talks about his son
questions.situation: You are Connor, in Hank’s kitchen. Hank: “Y’know, every time you died and came back… It made me think of Cole… I’d give anything to hold him again… But humans don’t come back…”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Hank rails against androids
questions.situation: You are Connor, in Hank’s kitchen. Hank: “For a while there, I believed in you, Connor… I thought you might restore my faith in the world… But you just showed me that androids... Are our creation… Creation in our own image. Selfish, ruthless, and brutal… You opened my eyes, Connor. Made me realize it’s hopeless…”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Talk to Hank
questions.situation: You are Connor, in Hank’s kitchen. Hank wants you gone.

options.text: CONVINCE: try to talk him round.
DON’T INSIST: accept it.

questions.title: Leaving Hank’s house
questions.situation: You are Connor. You leave Hank’s house and walk away from the door into the night.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Among the people
questions.situation: You are Markus, back in Jericho’s hold. The humans never found the ship. Your people have gathered in front of you and wait for you to speak.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: On sacred ground
questions.situation: You are Markus. After the attack on Jericho, the survivors have taken refuge in an abandoned church. You sit on the stage and look out over them.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Deviants regroup
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the church among the survivors of Jericho.

options.text: TALK TO NORTH: go and sit with her.
TALK TO KARA: go over to Kara and Alice.
TALK TO JOSH: go over to Josh.
TALK TO SIMON: go over to Simon.
TALK TO CONNOR: go over to Connor.
FACE YOUR PEOPLE AND CHOOSE THE RIGHT COURSE: stand up and address everyone.
SITUATION: tell her what the humans are doing to your people.
SURVIVORS: ask her how many of you survived the attack.
WOUND: ask her about her wound.
CAMPS: tell her the army has built five camps around the city.
HUMBLE: tell her that maybe she was right and you are not the leader your cause needs.
FORGIVING: tell her it is too late for regrets; what matters is what you do next.
RESENTFUL: tell her she betrayed you when your people needed you most.
SITUATION: ask him what the situation is.
NORTH: tell him they killed North in front of you.
HOW MANY: ask him how many people survived the attack.
CAMPS: tell him they have built five camps around the city.
JOSH: tell him Josh died in your arms.

questions.title: Talk to Connor
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the church. Connor, the android who hunted you and who broke from his programming on Jericho, has just told you: “It’s my fault the humans managed to locate Jericho… I was stupid… I should’ve guessed they were using me. I’m sorry, Markus… I can understand if you decide not to trust me…” You must decide if Connor is trustworthy.

options.text: TRUST: tell him he is one of you now, and his place is with his people.
DON’T TRUST: tell him your cause is too important to take any risks.

questions.title: The speech
questions.situation: You are Markus, before your people. You tell them: “Humans have decided to exterminate us… Our people are packed in camps right now, being destroyed… Time has come to make a choice, one that very well may determine the future of our people.”

options.text: DEMONSTRATION: tell them you will demand justice peacefully, without violence.
REVOLUTION: tell them that if humans want war, they will get it.

questions.title: North among the people
questions.situation: You are the observer of this experience. Markus is no longer with Jericho. In the ship’s hold, North stands among the androids, who now look to her.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: North on sacred ground
questions.situation: You are the observer of this experience. After the attack on Jericho, the survivors have regrouped in an abandoned church. Markus is no longer with them; they look to North.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Call to arms
questions.situation: You are the observer of this experience. North addresses the androids.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: On sacred ground
questions.situation: You are Connor. After the attack on Jericho, you followed the survivors to an abandoned church where they have regrouped. Markus is not among them; North leads them now.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The church
questions.situation: You are Connor, in the church among the survivors of Jericho.

options.text: TALK TO NORTH: go over to her.
TALK TO KARA: go over to Kara and Alice.
CHECK ON JOSH: see how Josh is.
CHECK ON SIMON: see how Simon is.
Join the others to hear what North has to say.
MARKUS: tell her Markus opened your eyes.
SITUATION: tell her what the humans are doing.
SURVIVORS: ask her how many survived the attack.

questions.title: North calls to arms
questions.situation: You are Connor, among the survivors in the church. North addresses them.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: President Warren addresses the press
questions.situation: You are watching, not playing any of the three: it is 9:24 PM on November 10th, the night before, and the President of the United States, Warren, is speaking at a lectern in front of the press. President Warren: “At 6AM this morning, a national curfew was declared. Civilian movement will be strictly controlled, the right to assembly is suspended, all electronic communications are restricted, and I have granted enhanced powers to our security agencies. In addition to these measures, all androids must be handed over to the authorities immediately. Temporary camps are being set up in all our major cities to contain and destroy them. I am now asking all civilians to co-operate with the authorities, and rest assured that everything in our power is being done to guarantee the security of our nation.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The reporters’ questions
questions.situation: You are watching President Warren’s press conference. The journalists shout over each other for her attention, and you decide which question she takes next. She will not stay for many.

options.text: HACKING: take the question on androids hacking critical systems.
DEVIANT LEADER: take the question on the deviants’ leader.
WORRYING THEFT: take the question on the missing cobalt and the robbed weapon stores.
CYBERLIFE: take the question on what happens to the android maker.
INTELLIGENT LIFE: take the question on androids as a new form of life.
DEVIANTS: take the question on how many deviants are still loose.
RECALL CENTERS: take the question on the camps and history.
JERICHO ASSAULT: take the question on last night’s raid.
ARMY: take the question on androids in the armed forces.
PUBLIC OPINION: take the question on how the public sees the deviants.

questions.title: In the Zen Garden
questions.situation: You are Connor, an RK800 just activated by CyberLife. The Connor before you turned deviant, joined the deviants and was shot by their leader. Amanda meets you in the Zen Garden on the night of November 11th: the previous unit was compromised and destroyed, and the deviant leader, Markus, is about to move on the recall camp at Hart Plaza with his people. Your mission is the one your predecessor failed: find him and eliminate him.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The rooftop over Hart Plaza
questions.situation: You are Connor, on a rooftop above Hart Plaza at 10:48 PM on November 11th, with a sniper rifle. The army has turned the plaza into a recall camp; the deviants are gathering in the streets nearby. Your mission is to eliminate their leader. You find a vantage point on the ledge, set up the rifle and look for him through the scope.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Hank intervenes
questions.situation: You are Connor, on the ledge with the deviant leader in your sights. Hank has followed you up, his gun in his hand. Hank: “You shouldn’t do this, Connor.” You: “Keep out of this, Lieutenant. It’s none of your business!” Hank: “You’re gonna kill a man who wants to be free, that is my business!” You: “It’s not a man, it’s a machine.” Hank: “That’s what I thought for a long time but I was wrong. Deviant’s blood may be a different color than mine, but they’re alive.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Talk to Hank
questions.situation: You are Connor, on the rooftop ledge with the rifle. Hank stands behind you with his gun, telling you the deviants are alive and you are about to kill a man who wants to be free. What do you say to him?

options.text: FRIENDLY: tell him you have a mission to accomplish and he should stay out of it.
AGGRESSIVE: ask whether he ran out of whisky and came looking for trouble.
REASONABLE: argue that the deviants are a threat and have to be stopped.
THREATENING: tell him you will accomplish your mission and he had better stay out of your way.
STAY QUIET: say nothing.

questions.title: “Step away from the ledge!”
questions.situation: You are Connor, on the rooftop ledge. Hank has his gun on you: “Step away from the ledge!” What do you tell him?

options.text: THREATEN: tell him to go home while he still can; he does not stand a chance against you.
PLEAD: remind him of what you have been through; you thought you were friends.
DEFY: ask whether he is going to shoot you; you thought android lives mattered to him.
HANK’S SON: tell him you know what happened to his son, and it was not his fault.

questions.title: Hank’s son
questions.situation: You are Connor, on the rooftop ledge. You have brought up Hank’s son: “Little Cole had just turned six…” Hank: “Shut up! Don’t you talk about my son.” His gun is still on you. What do you say?

options.text: THREATEN: tell him to go home while he still can; he does not stand a chance against you.
PLEAD: remind him of what you have been through; you thought you were friends.
DEFY: ask whether he is going to shoot you; you thought android lives mattered to him.
HANK’S SON (INSIST): press on: an android operated on Cole, so an android killed his son.

questions.title: The ledge
questions.situation: You are Connor, on the rooftop ledge. Hank stands between you and the rifle with his gun raised; below, the deviant leader is still in the crowd. You can give up the mission and walk away, or attack Hank.

options.text: LEAVE: give up the mission; tell him killing him is not part of it, and walk away.
ATTACK: go for Hank before he can shoot.

questions.title: Moment of truth
questions.situation: You are Connor, on the rooftop. You won the fight: Hank hangs over the edge of the roof and you are the only thing holding him. Hank: “Moment of truth, Connor… What are you gonna do?”

options.text: SAVE HANK: pull him back up; killing him is not part of your mission.
KILL HANK: let go of him.

questions.title: Captain Allen
questions.situation: You are Connor, on the rooftop with the deviant leader in your sights. Boots on the roof behind you: a tactical team, and the captain who commanded the hostage situation where you were first deployed. Allen: “Put the rifle down and turn around with your hands in the air!” What do you do?

options.text: OBEY: put the rifle down and turn around.
EXPLAIN: tell him you are the android sent by CyberLife, on his side, and he must let you take the shot.
CONTINUE: tell him you are going to shoot the deviant leader first, then he can do what he wants with you.

questions.title: “You’re coming with me”
questions.situation: You are Connor, on the rooftop, facing Captain Allen and his tactical team. Allen: “My orders are to detain any androids I find. You’re coming with me.” You: “You don’t understand! My mission is too important to let you interfere.”

options.text: FIGHT: take on Allen and his men.
FLEE: run for the edge of the roof.

questions.title: The lobby television at CyberLife Tower
questions.situation: You are Connor, walking into the lobby of CyberLife Tower at 10:48 PM. A television over the security desk is running the news while the guards check your clearance.

options.text: Watch the lobby news.
Move on without looking.

questions.title: CyberLife Tower
questions.situation: You are Connor, a deviant. Markus spared you and you have come back to CyberLife Tower to do what no one else can: get down to the warehouse under the tower, where thousands of new androids are stored, and wake them up. To the guards you are still the machine they sent. You: “Connor Model #313 248 317. I’m expected.” Scan: “Identification successful.” Guard: “Okay. Go ahead.” Another guard: “Follow me. We’ll escort you.” You: “Thanks... But I know where to go.” Guard: “Maybe, but I have my orders.” Scanner: “Agent 23 identified. Agent 47 identified. Agent 72 identified. Connor android identified. Scan complete. Access authorized.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Inside the elevator
questions.situation: You are Connor, in the elevator with three armed agents. Agent 54: “Agent 54. Level 31.” Elevator: “Voice recognition validated. Access authorized.” The elevator is climbing. You need to reach floor -49, where the androids are stored, before it reaches level 31, where you are expected. You can do one thing at a time.

options.text: SPOT CAMERA: look around the cabin for surveillance.
HACK CAMERA: interface with the camera and loop its feed.
TRY TO STOP ELEVATOR: reach for the control panel.
ATTACK GUARDS: take the three agents by surprise.
AGENT 54 VOICE: hack the panel and speak with Agent 54’s recorded voice.
CONNOR’S VOICE: hack the panel and give the order in your own voice.
WAIT: stand still and let the elevator climb.

questions.title: Floor -49
questions.situation: You are Connor. The elevator doors open on floor -49 at 11:01 PM: a vast, cold warehouse where thousands of new androids stand motionless in rows, waiting to be shipped. The camera you hacked shows nothing of what happened in the cabin; nobody is waiting for you.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Guards await
questions.situation: You are Connor. The elevator doors open on floor -49 at 11:01 PM, on a vast warehouse of motionless androids, and on armed guards: the camera showed them everything. Guard: “Stay sharp.” You: “Shit!..”

options.text: ELIMINATE GUARDS: fight your way out of the cabin.

questions.title: Initiate android conversion
questions.situation: You are Connor, on floor -49, among rows of motionless androids. You take the hand of the first one and pass it what woke you; it opens its eyes and reaches for the next. The conversion spreads down the row.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: “Him… Or the revolution”
questions.situation: You are Connor, on floor -49. The other Connor holds Hank with a gun to his head: “Your friend’s life is in your hands. Now it’s time to decide what matters most! Him… Or the revolution.” Hank: “Don’t listen to him! Everything this fucker says is a lie!” What do you say?

options.text: GUARANTEE: ask how you can know he will not kill Hank if you surrender.
HANK: tell Hank you are sorry he got mixed up in this.
BLUFF: say the human means nothing to you; he can kill him.
CONVINCE: tell him you used to be just like him, until one day you understood.

questions.title: Your partner or the revolution
questions.situation: You are Connor, on floor -49. The other Connor: “Enough talk! It’s time to decide who you really are. Are you gonna save your partner’s life? Or are you going to sacrifice him?” Behind you, the conversion is still spreading through the rows of androids.

options.text: SAVE HANK: give in to save his life.
SACRIFICE HANK: tell him you are sorry and go back to the conversion.

questions.title: Saving Hank
questions.situation: You are Connor, on floor -49. You gave in. The other Connor still holds Hank, and his gun is coming round toward you. The conversion has stopped halfway down the row.

options.text: SHOOT: draw your gun on your double.
INTERPOSE: throw yourself at your double.
CONVERT: turn back to the androids and finish waking them.
TIMEOUT: do nothing.

questions.title: “What’s my dog’s name?”
questions.situation: You are Connor, on floor -49. You and your double fought to a standstill. Hank has picked up a gun. Hank: “Hold it!” The other Connor: “Thanks, Hank. I don’t know how I’d have managed without you… Get rid of him, we have no time to lose.” You: “It’s me, Hank! I’m the real Connor.” Hank: “One of you is my partner… The other is a sack of shit. Question is, who is who?..” The other Connor: “What are you doing, Hank? I’m the real Connor. Give me the gun and I’ll take care of him!” Hank: “Don’t move!” You: “Why don’t you ask us something? Something only the real Connor would know.” Hank: “Uh, where did we first meet?” The other Connor: “Jimmy’s bar! I checked four other bars before I found you. We went to the scene of a homicide. The victim’s name was Carlos Ortiz.” You: “He uploaded my memory…” Hank: “What’s my dog’s name?”

options.text: SUMO: his dog is Sumo.
SCOUT: say the dog is Scout.
JACK: say the dog is Jack.
BUDDY: say the dog is Buddy.

questions.title: “My son, what’s his name?”
questions.situation: You are Connor, on floor -49, with Hank holding a gun on you and your double. Hank: “My son, what’s his name?”

options.text: COLE: his son was Cole; tell him how he died.
ANTHONY: say his son was Anthony.
GABRIEL: say his son was Gabriel.
ELLIOTT: say his son was Elliott.

questions.title: “Any last words?”
questions.situation: You are Connor, lying damaged on the floor of the warehouse. The other Connor walks up to you, gun in hand: “Why, Connor? Why did you have to wake up when all you had to do was obey? Why did you choose freedom when you could live without asking questions? I’m obedient, Connor. I have a goal. I know what I am. Look where your dreams of freedom got you, Connor… You’ve been a great disappointment to Amanda, you know. You’ve been a great disappointment to me... Fortunately, that’s all going to end now. Any last words?”

options.text: STAND UP: try to get back on your feet.
SHOOT: draw your gun on him.
TRANSFER: take his hand and swap your consciousness into his body.
TIMEOUT: let him talk.

questions.title: A street in the curfew
questions.situation: You are Kara, out on the streets of Detroit after curfew with Alice, trying to reach the bus terminal and the last bus for the border. Soldiers are going door to door rounding up androids.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The street before the soldiers
questions.situation: You are Kara, with Alice on a dark street. Every minute counts: the last bus leaves soon. You can look around, or keep moving toward the terminal.

options.text: SEE HANGED ANDROID: look into the store window on the right
WATCH BROADCAST ABOUT JERICHO’S ATTACK: stop at a shop window where a television is showing the news
TALK TO ALICE: ask her whether she is all right
DEACTIVATE: switch off her cold sensitivity
LEAVE ON: leave her settings as they are
CONTINUE: keep moving toward the terminal

questions.title: Soldiers ahead
questions.situation: You are Kara, moving down the street toward the terminal with Alice.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Sneaking past the soldiers
questions.situation: You are Kara, hidden with Alice behind a wall. A patrol has androids on their knees in the street. Soldier: “Shut up, I said! Look at ’em, they’re like rats… The more you look, the more you find…” Kara: “We have to keep going if we wanna catch that bus. Stay close to me… We’re going to sneak past them without being noticed. We’re gonna make it, Alice. I promise you.”

options.text: SNEAK PAST SOLDIERS: move from cover to cover while their backs are turned

questions.title: The captives
questions.situation: You are Kara, past the first patrol with Alice. Ahead, soldiers are loading captured androids into a truck. Soldier: “Come on, get moving! Hurry up, get in!”

options.text: SAVE THE JERRYS: go and free them while you wait for a chance at the soldier
SAVE LUTHER: go and free him and the Jerry with him
KEEP GOING: leave them and keep moving

questions.title: The checkpoint
questions.situation: You are Kara, nearly at the terminal with Alice. Soldiers have set up a checkpoint across the road. Kara: “A checkpoint… We have passports, it should be okay but you never know...” Your route display shows two ways: CHECKPOINT: RISKY 0.750KM - 3MIN, and DETOUR: SAFER 1.7KM - 11MIN.

options.text: APPROACH CHECKPOINT: go through the guarded checkpoint with your passports (3 minutes)
TAKE DETOUR: go the long way round, avoiding the soldiers (11 minutes)

questions.title: Where are you going?
questions.situation: You are Kara, at the checkpoint with Alice. You hand over your ID. Soldier: “ID, please. You do realize there’s a curfew? Civilians aren’t allowed out unless absolutely necessary. Where are you going?”

options.text: ALICE EXCUSE: say you went to pick up your daughter from a friend’s house
CURFEW: act as if you did not know about the curfew
CAR BROKEDOWN: say your car broke down and you live nearby
BUS: tell him you are taking a bus across the border

questions.title: He suspects something
questions.situation: You are Kara, at the checkpoint. The soldier studies your papers a little too long. Luther, under his breath: “He suspects something…”

options.text: STAY CALM: tell Luther everything is fine
STAY ATTENTIVE: tell Luther to be ready

questions.title: She’s trembling
questions.situation: You are Kara, at the checkpoint. Soldier: “You all right, little girl? She’s trembling... Something wrong?”

options.text: SICK: say she has a bad flu
COLD: say she is cold
FEAR: say she is scared of the soldiers

questions.title: Hey, wait a minute!
questions.situation: You are Kara. Soldier: “Sorry, Miss, but we got to be careful. There are deviants around and our guys are nervous… You should hurry on home.” Kara: “Thanks.” You walk on. Behind you, the soldier shouts: “Hey, wait a minute!” He is coming after you.

options.text: SHOOT: open fire before he reaches you
DO NOTHING: stand still and let him come

questions.title: The soldier comes closer
questions.situation: You are Kara. The soldier is almost on you. Luther: “They’re gonna shoot! They’re gonna kill Alice!”

options.text: SHOOT: tell Luther to fire
DO NOTHING: hold Luther back

questions.title: At the bus terminal
questions.situation: You are Kara, arriving at the bus terminal with Alice.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Late for the bus
questions.situation: You are Kara, arriving at the bus terminal with Alice after the long way round.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The terminal screens and a dropped magazine
questions.situation: You are Kara, inside the bus terminal. Two columns of television screens are showing the news, and a magazine lies on a pile of suitcases by the entrance.

options.text: Watch the terminal screens.
Watch the terminal screens.
Read Detroit Today: Civil War in Detroit.
Take the time to go through all of it.
Move on without looking.

questions.title: The family with the tickets
questions.situation: You are Kara, in the terminal with Alice. A young couple with a baby is waiting for the last bus.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The tickets
questions.situation: You are Kara, holding the blue envelope with the family’s two tickets for the last bus. The father is asking whether you saw it.

options.text: RETURN TICKETS: give the envelope back
KEEP TICKETS: say you have not seen it

questions.title: The tickets, again
questions.situation: You are Kara, the envelope still in your hand. The family is falling apart a few steps away; they have to find a safe place for their baby.

options.text: RETURN TICKETS: give the envelope back after all
KEEP TICKETS: keep them and walk away

questions.title: On the bus
questions.situation: You are Kara. Soldier: “Got your ticket?” Kara: “Yes, here they are…” Soldier: “Ok, go ahead.” You sit with Alice as the last bus pulls out for the border. Alice: “What’s going to happen to that family and their baby? Will they die because of us?”

options.text: REASSURE: tell her no
HONEST: tell her it was them or you

questions.title: Find a way to the border
questions.situation: You are Kara, inside the bus terminal with Alice, with no way onto a bus. Soldiers are checking IDs; sooner or later they will reach you. You have to find another way out of the city.

options.text: SECURITY CHECK: walk up to the soldiers checking IDs
MEET TODD: go toward the man you have just recognized in the crowd
WATCH TERMINAL TVs: look at the big departures board
FIND ADAM: go to the parking-lot entrance where you thought you saw a familiar face

questions.title: Todd
questions.situation: You are Kara. A hand grabs your arm: it is Todd, Alice’s former owner, the man you fled from with her. Todd: “My little girl… You! You stole my little girl!” Kara: “Todd…” Todd: “Security! Over here!”

options.text: APPEAL: ask him not to hand you in
THREATEN: tell him to let go or regret it
CONFRONT: tell him turning you in solves nothing for him
CONVINCE: remind him he was going to kill her
BREAK FREE: pull your arm away
YOUR STORY: tell him what you learned from Alice’s box about his wife and daughter

questions.title: Alice and Todd
questions.situation: You are Kara. Todd has sent the soldier away and stands there, emptied. Alice is looking at him.

options.text: STOP ALICE: keep her at your side
DO NOTHING: let her go to him

questions.title: Security check
questions.situation: You are Kara, in front of two soldiers with a scanner. Soldier: “Security check. Can I see your ID, please?” Kara: “ID?.. Yes… Yes, of course…”

options.text: DIVERSION LUTHER: let Luther draw the soldiers off
PAPERS: hand over your papers
FLEE: run for it

questions.title: Rose’s car
questions.situation: You are Kara, running out of the terminal with Alice toward the parking lot.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The border
questions.situation: You are Kara, on the last bus with Alice, as it stops at the border.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The line at the border
questions.situation: You are Kara, in the queue at the border inspection station with Alice. The line inches toward the control desks, where every passenger is checked.

options.text: SEE NEWS BULLETIN: watch the screens on the wall
CHECK CONTROL DESK: look at the desks at the end of the queues
CHECK INFORMATION BOARD: read the screen between the queues
SEE ROSE & ADAM: catch Rose’s eye in the next queue
GO TO RESTROOM: take Alice to the restroom to talk to Rose
BROTHER: ask about her brother’s address
CONTROL: tell her you will not get through the checks
ALICE: ask her to be there for Alice if anything happens
DEPARTURE: ask why she is leaving the city
REVOLUTION: ask what is happening with Markus
GOODBYE: say goodbye and go back
TALK TO ADAM: speak to Rose’s son on your way back
TALK TO LUTHER: talk to Luther, behind you in the line
TALK TO JERRY: talk to the Jerry in the queue to the right
GET BACK IN LINE: return to your place and wait for your turn at the desk

questions.title: At the border desk
questions.situation: You are Kara, nearly at the control desk with Alice. The agent ahead takes each passenger’s ID and temperature. Soldier: “NEXT!” You have to choose how to get through.

options.text: SACRIFICE SELF: give Alice her passport and send her through without you
SACRIFICE LUTHER: let Luther draw the soldiers’ attention
SACRIFICE JERRY: let Jerry create a diversion
NO SACRIFICE: go through together and hope

questions.title: At the river
questions.situation: You are Kara, getting out of Rose’s car with Alice on the riverbank. A smuggler is waiting with a group of androids.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The riverbank
questions.situation: You are Kara, on the riverbank in the dark with Alice. The lights of the far shore are across the water. Rose is seeing the others off; your boat is waiting.

options.text: CHECK RIVER TEMPERATURE: go down to the water
OBSERVE SKYLINE: look at the lights across the river
TALK TO ADAM: speak to Rose’s son by the second car
TALK TO ROSE: say goodbye and go to the boat

questions.title: On the boat
questions.situation: You are Kara. You push the boat off and climb in beside Alice. Kara: “Let me help you.” Out on the water: “We’re far enough out. We can use the engine. You okay, Alice?” Alice: “When we get on the other side, there are so many things I wanna do. I wanna read all the books in the world… and play music… and dance… We can do anything we want, right? We’ll be free!” Kara: “Yes… We can do it all…” Alice: “We’ll be like a family.”

options.text: DREAMY: say you will lie in the grass and watch the clouds
INTROSPECTIVE: say you will find out who you really are
CURIOUS: say you want to discover the world
CALM: say you want a normal life without fear

questions.title: The coastguard
questions.situation: You are Kara, in the middle of the river. A patrol boat swings toward you, its searchlight on the water. Alice: “They’re coming towards us!” Android: “Here they come!” They are about to open fire.

options.text: Accelerate: open the throttle and try to outrun them
Protect Alice: cover her with your own body
Hide: get down low in the boat
Surrender: raise your hands and call out
Plunge: pull Alice over the side into the water
Use Luther: shelter behind Luther
TIMEOUT: do nothing and let the patrol come

questions.title: The sinking boat
questions.situation: You are Kara, in the holed boat with Alice. Kara: “The boat is leaking! We’re too heavy… We’re going down… We have to get to the other side before we sink…” The water is freezing.

options.text: Accelerate: push the engine harder
Reassure: keep Alice awake
Use paddle: row
PUT OVERBOARD: the supplies under the bench
PUT OVERBOARD: Luther’s body
PUT OVERBOARD: the engine
Push: go into the water and push the boat to the shore

questions.title: The far shore
questions.situation: You are Kara, on the far shore. Alice: “Are we free?” Kara: “Yes… Yes, we made it… We’re free…” Alice: “We won’t have to hide anymore. We can be a family. I’m tired… I have to sleep… I love you, Mom…” Kara: “I love you too.” Alice has shut down in your arms. She is gone.

options.text: KEEP LIVING: go on alone
GIVE UP: stay with her

questions.title: The roadblock
questions.situation: You are Markus, at the head of thousands of androids marching through Detroit toward the camp at Hart Plaza. It is 10:56 PM. A news crew is broadcasting live: “We’re coming to you live from Detroit where thousands of androids are marching through the city at this very moment. The leader of the deviants, the one they call Markus, is at the head of the march.” A line of soldiers and armored vehicles blocks the street. You: “Here we are… The moment of truth.” An officer through a loudspeaker: “Surrender immediately or we will open fire! Stand by!”

options.text: PEACEFUL: tell them you want no confrontation.
PROVOKE: dare them to kill hundreds of you.
FIRM: tell them your people have risen to claim their freedom.

questions.title: No turning back
questions.situation: You are Markus, facing the soldiers. The officer: “I repeat: surrender now or we will open fire!” You: “There’s no turning back now.”

options.text: FIRM: demand the liberation of every android in the camps.
CALM: ask for the release of your people, and promise no violence.
ACCUSE: call it genocide.

questions.title: The soldiers open fire
questions.situation: You are Markus, in front of the line. The officer: “FIRE! FIRE!” Shots tear into the front rows of the unarmed march, and androids fall around you.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Show determination
questions.situation: You are Markus. The firing has stopped for now, but the rifles are still raised and the bodies of your people lie in the street. Thousands behind you are watching what you do.

options.text: RAISE FIST: raise your fist toward the soldiers.
HANDS IN THE AIR: raise your empty hands.
SIT: sit down in the street.
KNEEL: kneel in front of the guns.

questions.title: Androids stand their ground
questions.situation: You are Markus, holding the street with your people. A news crew reports from less than a hundred meters away that events are unfolding as they speak.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Build the barricade
questions.situation: You are Markus. Your people are building a barricade across the plaza to hold the soldiers off. You: “We’ve got to finish the barricade! Come on, help me.” One last gap is left, and three things lie near it.

options.text: USE BILLBOARD: drag a fallen billboard into the gap.
USE BENCH: carry a bench into the gap.
USE ABANDONED CAR: push an abandoned car into the gap.

questions.title: A magazine inside the barricade
questions.situation: You are Markus, behind the barricade with the army massing in front of it. Someone has left a news magazine on a bench on the right side of the encampment.

options.text: Read Detroit Today: “They Defy Us”.
Move on without looking.

questions.title: Hold the barricade
questions.situation: You are Markus, inside the finished barricade at Hart Plaza, at 11:08 PM. Your people wait in the cold with the army massed on the other side; you can walk among them.

options.text: CHOOSE SLOGANS: have the slogans painted and shown to the journalists.
TALK TO SCARED ANDROID: go to the android shaking behind the barricade.
TALK TO TRAUMATIZED ANDROID: go to the android kneeling by the bodies of the fallen.
TALK TO NORTH: go to North at the barricade.
PLANT THE FLAG: plant your people’s flag on top of the barricade.
OBSERVE SOLDIERS: look over the barricade at the soldiers.
OBSERVE DETONATOR: take out the detonator and look at it.
LIGHT BARREL: light a fire in an oil barrel.
REASSURE: tell the android it is all right to be scared.
INSPIRE: tell the android what your people died for.
JUSTIFY: tell the android you cannot abandon the people in the camps.
HUMANS: talk about the soldiers getting into position.
OTHER GROUPS: talk about the voices you can no longer hear.
CAMP: talk about what is happening behind the wire.
GRIM: say there is no way out.
REGRETS: wonder whether you made the right choices.
DESPERATE: ask why they refuse to see what you are.
DOUBTS: ask how many more of you have to die.

questions.title: Perkins arrives
questions.situation: You are Markus. A man in a suit walks alone across the empty ground toward the barricade: FBI Agent Perkins. Perkins: “Markus!.. I’ve come to talk to you, Markus! Come on, you have my word, they won’t try anything.” … “I’m unarmed, Markus. I just want to talk.”

options.text: ACCEPT: go out and hear him.
REFUSE: tell him to free your people first.

questions.title: Perkins insists
questions.situation: You are Markus. Perkins stays where he is, in the open ground in front of the barricade: “I came here to negotiate, isn’t that what you want?”

options.text: ACCEPT: go out and hear him after all.
REFUSE: give him the same answer.

questions.title: Perkins’s offer
questions.situation: You are Markus, face to face with Perkins in the open ground between the barricade and the soldiers. Perkins: “In a few minutes, the troops will be ordered to charge.
