None of you will survive… It will all be over. But you can avoid that, Markus.” You: “What do you mean?” Perkins: “Surrender. Surrender and I give you my word your life will be spared. They’ll be detained but, none of you will be destroyed.”

options.text: OTHER DEMONSTRATIONS: ask what happened to the androids demonstrating in the camps.
GUARANTEES?: ask how you would know he will keep his word.
NOT AFRAID: tell him you are not afraid to die.
BETRAY PEOPLE?: ask whether he is asking you to betray your people.
ACCEPT DEAL: surrender, on his word that your people will live.
REFUSE DEAL: refuse to betray your people.

questions.title: In the dismantled barricade
questions.situation: You are Markus, back among your people. Military trucks roll up to the barricade; the soldiers take it apart and start loading the androids.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Among the trucks
questions.situation: You are Markus, standing in the ruins of the barricade while your people are led to the trucks. Perkins waits by the soldiers.

options.text: TALK TO PERKINS: go and tell him it is done.
TALK TO NORTH: go to North first.

questions.title: The deviant leader is dead
questions.situation: You are Connor, still a machine on CyberLife’s mission, arriving at Hart Plaza after the androids’ surrender. The barricade is in pieces and soldiers are loading androids into trucks.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Soldiers attack the barricade
questions.situation: You are Markus, back behind the barricade after turning Perkins down. The soldiers are forming up for the charge.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Defending the barricade
questions.situation: You are Markus. The soldiers are advancing behind the smoke, shooting at the androids fleeing the barricade. Some of your people are pinned in the open.

options.text: SAVE FLEEING ANDROIDS: run out under fire and get them to cover.
Stay down behind the barricade and let them run.

questions.title: Cornered
questions.situation: You are Markus, driven back against a wall with the last of your people. The soldiers close in around you.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The last stand
questions.situation: You are Markus, cornered with your people, the soldiers’ rifles raised. There is no way out.

options.text: DIRTY BOMB: take out the detonator.
KISS NORTH: kiss North in front of the guns.
SING: begin to sing, and let your people take up the song.
SACRIFICE: set yourself on fire in front of the soldiers.
DO NOTHING: stand with your people and wait.
GIVE UP: put the detonator away.
PRESS: press the detonator.

questions.title: The message
questions.situation: You are Markus. It is 10:56 on the night of November 11, 2038. The androids have chosen to fight: tonight they will attack the camp by Hart Plaza where captured androids are held for destruction. Before the attack you record a message for the journalists: “Today, November 11th 2038, is the day the android people rose up against their oppressors. We’ve been fighting since dawn to liberate our fellow androids from the camps. We won’t cease hostilities until we are free and negotiations begin to grant us equal rights. There are millions of us and we will stop at nothing.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Charge the barricade
questions.situation: You are Markus, at Hart Plaza at 11:01 with the androids massed behind you and soldiers behind a barricade ahead. North, if she is beside you: “Freedom or death.”

options.text: CHARGE THE BARRICADE: lead the androids across the open plaza at the soldiers’ barricade

questions.title: The crossroad
questions.situation: You are Markus. The barricade at Hart Plaza falls and you plant the androids’ flag on it. Then the soldiers regroup at the crossroad on the way to the camp.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Josh leaves cover
questions.situation: You are Markus, pinned behind cover on the approach to the camp. Josh breaks cover ahead of you and goes down in the open. Markus: “JOSH!”

options.text: RESCUE JOSH: run out under fire and drag him back
JOSH IS SHOT: stay in cover and keep the assault moving

questions.title: Approaching the recall center
questions.situation: You are Markus, advancing through the streets toward the camp under fire, with androids sheltering behind every wall and sandbag. Ahead, a frightened android cowers in the open; an android crouches behind the sandbags beside you; you have a grenade. The machine gun covering the camp’s approach is still ahead.

options.text: INSPIRE FRIGHTENED ANDROID: reach the android cowering in the open
TALK TO ANDROID BEHIND SAND BAGS: crouch beside him for a moment
THROW GRENADE: throw it at the soldiers’ position ahead
KEEP ADVANCING: push on toward the pillar and the machine gun
STAY HERE: tell him to hide where he is until it is over
GO BACK: tell him to go back and hide
ADVANCE!: tell him to keep going forward

questions.title: Simon is shot
questions.situation: You are Markus, at the pillar. Simon: “We lost a lot of our people!.. We gotta move faster or we’ll never reach the camp!” He breaks forward and is shot down in the open, still alive.

options.text: TRY TO SAVE SIMON: suppress the shooters and go out for him
KEEP GOING: leave him and push on

questions.title: North offers her heart
questions.situation: You are Markus, badly wounded, down behind cover, your systems failing. North reaches you: “Markus!..” Markus: “Okay… It’s okay… You’ll make it with- without me… Our cause… That’s all that matters…” North: “No... No, we can’t win without you!.. Our hearts are compatible. You have to take mine.” Markus: “I can’t let you do that!” North: “You’re the only one who can lead us, Markus! It’s the only way. If you die, our cause dies with you.”

options.text: SACRIFICE NORTH: take her heart
SACRIFICE SELF: refuse her heart

questions.title: Simon offers his heart
questions.situation: You are Markus, badly wounded, down behind cover, your systems failing. Simon reaches you: “Markus!” Markus: “It’s okay… It’s okay… You can make it without me… Our cause… is all that matters…” Simon: “No... No! We can’t win without you!.. Our hearts are compatible. You have to take mine.” Markus: “No... Simon, no…” Simon: “You’re the only one that can lead us. You’ve got to live. If you don’t, you’ll die! And our cause will die with you! Set our people free, Markus…”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Nobody to save Markus
questions.situation: You are Markus, badly wounded, down behind cover. Your systems are failing and nobody reaches you.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The machine gun
questions.situation: You are Markus, at the last stretch before the camp. Android: “We can’t move forward… That machine gun is taking down everything that moves!..” You have to coordinate the attack on it: one group covers while the other charges.

options.text: NORTH’S GROUP WILL COVER: North’s group lays down covering fire while yours charges the gun
NORTH’S GROUP WILL CHARGE: send North’s group at the gun now, with nobody covering them
GROUP WILL COVER: one group lays down covering fire while yours charges the gun

questions.title: The drone
questions.situation: You are Markus, at the captured machine gun. North: “We’re nearly there, Markus.” A police drone swoops on North’s group.

options.text: SHOOT DRONE: bring the drone down before it reaches them

questions.title: The final assault
questions.situation: You are Markus, at the gates of Recall Center N°5 at 11:07, the androids pouring in behind you.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Connor finds Markus
questions.situation: You are watching the final assault on the camp. Markus lies stunned by an explosion. A machine Connor, sent by CyberLife, steps out of the smoke: “It took me a while to find you, Markus.” The two of them will fight; you choose whose side of the fight to play.

options.text: CONTROL CONNOR: fight as Connor, to stop Markus
CONTROL MARKUS: fight as Markus, to stop Connor

questions.title: Soldiers approach
questions.situation: You are Markus, on the ground after the explosion at the camp gates. Soldiers close in on you.

options.text: NEUTRALIZE SOLDIERS: fight them off from where you lie

questions.title: Androids have to fall back
questions.situation: You are Markus. The assault on the camp has failed. The androids break and run under the soldiers’ fire.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Connor arrives
questions.situation: You are Connor, a machine sent by CyberLife, inside an abandoned CyberLife store where the android leader has taken shelter alone after the failed assault. Markus faces you, unarmed: “The humans won… Our people have been slaughtered… Go ahead… Take my life. It won’t change anything.” You: “My mission is to neutralize the leader of the rogue androids… and I always accomplish my mission.” Markus: “We fought for a dream and we lost… But nobody can stem the tide of history. One day we will prevail. Thousands of our people died today. What difference does one more make?”

options.text: SHOOT: shoot Markus
SPARE: lower your gun
NO CHOICE: let the moment pass without deciding

questions.title: The detonator
questions.situation: You are Markus, in the abandoned CyberLife store with the machine Connor. Your hand closes on the detonator of the dirty bomb you took at Jericho.

options.text: DETONATE THE BOMB: set off the dirty bomb
DO NOT DETONATE: leave the detonator alone

questions.title: Soldiers surround the store
questions.situation: You are Markus, alone in an abandoned CyberLife store after the failed assault, with a gun. Soldier: “We have you surrounded, come out now! I repeat: Come out now with your hands in the air. If you surrender now, we will not shoot.”

options.text: SUICIDE: turn the gun on yourself
SURRENDER: walk out with your hands up
DIRTY BOMB: press the detonator

questions.title: Inside the store with North
questions.situation: You are Markus, with North in an abandoned CyberLife store after the failed assault. Soldier: “We have you surrounded, come out now! I repeat: Come out now with your hands in the air.” North: “It can’t end like this… We’re not gonna give up, we can still get out of here!..” Soldier: “If you surrender now, we will not shoot.”

options.text: KISS: kiss North
DIRTY BOMB: take out the detonator
SUICIDE: raise the gun to your own head
SURRENDER: walk out with North
PRESS: set off the dirty bomb
GIVE UP: put the detonator away
CONFIRM SUICIDE: pull the trigger
PUT DOWN: lower the gun

questions.title: North at Hart Plaza
questions.situation: The android leader Markus is gone, and North leads the androids against the camp by Hart Plaza. You are watching. Her message to the journalists: “Today, November 11th 2038, is the day the android people rose up against their oppressors. We have been fighting to liberate our fellow androids from the camps since dawn. We won’t cease hostilities until our people are free and negotiations begin to grant us equal rights. There are millions of us and we will stop at nothing.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Find North
questions.situation: You are Connor, a machine sent by CyberLife, inside an abandoned CyberLife store where the rogue androids’ leader, North, has taken shelter after the failed attack. You find her. North: “You can take my life… It doesn’t matter anymore.” You: “My mission is to neutralize the leader of the rogue androids… and I always accomplish my mission.” North: “We fought for our dream and we lost… But you can’t hold my people down forever… One day we’ll rise up again, and we will win. Go on. Shoot. What are you waiting for?”

options.text: SHOOT: shoot North
SPARE: lower your gun
TIME OUT: let the moment pass without deciding

questions.title: The truck to the recall center
questions.situation: You are Kara, in the back of an army truck with Alice and other captured androids, NOV 11TH, 10:51 PM. The truck has stopped at a recall center: floodlights, fences, soldiers. Alice presses against you. “Where are they taking us?”

options.text: WARN: tell her you both have to be strong
REASSURE: promise her that together nothing can hurt you
LIE: say they are only keeping androids safe until things calm down
SINCERE: admit you do not know

questions.title: Hands on your heads
questions.situation: You are Kara, at the tailgate of the truck with Alice. Soldiers are pulling androids out and shouting: “HANDS ON YOUR HEADS!”

options.text: GET OUT OF TRUCK: climb down with your hands on your head
WAIT: stay in the truck a moment longer

questions.title: The gate
questions.situation: You are Kara, in the line at the gate of the recall center. Soldier: “Forward!” Alice: “I’m scared… I… I don’t wanna go…” Kara: “There’s no choice, Alice…” Soldier: “Next!” Alice: “No, Kara… I… I can’t…”

options.text: REASSURE: tell her there is nothing to be scared of
REASON: explain that disobeying will get you both hurt
FRIGHTEN: warn her they will kill you both
ORDER: tell her to go through now

questions.title: The soldier becomes impatient
questions.situation: You are Kara, at the gate. Alice will not move, and the soldier is losing patience: “You first!”

options.text: PERSUADE SOLDIER: tell him she will go now
PERSUADE ALICE: beg her to do it for you
SHIELD ALICE: step between her and the soldier

questions.title: The tent
questions.situation: You are Kara, behind Alice at the entrance of a tent where androids are processed. Soldier: “Come on, it’s your turn.”

options.text: REACH THE TENT: go in after her
WAIT: hang back at the entrance

questions.title: Leaving the tent
questions.situation: You are Kara, in the tent with Alice, skin deactivated, your clothes in the dumpster. Soldier: “Come on, this way! Get a move on!”

options.text: LEAVE TENT: walk out the far side with her
WAIT: stay where you are a moment longer

questions.title: The body
questions.situation: You are Kara, just out of the tent with Alice. An android breaks for the fence and is shot dead (DEVIANT SHOT TRYING TO ESCAPE). A soldier points at the android beside you: “You! Take this one to the dump!” Android: “No… no… Please, I beg you…” Soldier: “I gave you an order! Obey, now!”

options.text: VOLUNTEER: offer to carry the body yourself
SAY NOTHING: keep your head down

questions.title: The dump
questions.situation: You are Kara, alone at the dump with the body. Alice is somewhere back toward the pens. Beside the dump stands an army truck loaded with bodies, its engine running; nobody is watching it.

options.text: GO BACK: return toward the pens to find Alice
CLIMB TRUCK: climb up onto the truck

questions.title: On the truck
questions.situation: You are Kara, hidden among the bodies on the truck at the dump. The engine is running; in a moment it will drive out of the camp. Alice is still inside, in one of the pens.

options.text: GO BACK: climb down and go back in for Alice
LEAVE: stay on the truck and leave the camp

questions.title: Inside the enclosure
questions.situation: You are Kara, pushed into a fenced pen packed with androids (INSIDE THE ENCLOSURE). Alice is not here. Kara: “ALICE!”

options.text: CALL: call out for Alice

questions.title: Explore the enclosure
questions.situation: You are Kara, in a pen at the recall center, looking for Alice. A drone sweeps the pens with its light; whoever moves in its beam is shot.

options.text: TALK TO JERRY: speak to the Jerry on the left side of the pen
TALK TO OTHER JERRY: cross to the next pen to the other Jerry
TALK TO LUTHER: go to Luther at the far end of the pen
TALK TO SCARRED ANDROID: speak to the scarred android from Zlatko’s basement
TALK TO RESCUED ANDROID: speak to the android whose place you took at the body
TALK TO RALPH: speak to Ralph, rocking and muttering by the fence
EXIT ENCLOSURE: follow the soldiers’ orders out of the pen
MOVE: get out of the drone’s light
REMAIN STILL: freeze and stay silent
INTERVENE: try to stop the soldiers taking Luther
DON’T INTERVENE: let them take him
INSIST: ask him again about the girl
CALM DOWN: tell him to keep calm or the humans will hurt him
GIVE UP: leave him be
INSIST: press him for an answer about Alice
CALM DOWN: look him in the eye and tell him nobody will hurt him
GIVE UP: leave him be
CAPTURED: ask whether they were captured too
ALICE: ask whether he has seen the girl
HERE: ask why they have all been gathered here

questions.title: Alice is terrified
questions.situation: You are Kara, marched with the others into a long row of lines facing a set of doors (JOIN LINE). You find Alice: she is two lines away, alone, at the front of hers. Kara: “Alice!” Alice: “Kara!” Kara: “No, Alice! Don’t move!” Alice: “But I’m scared!”

options.text: FIRM: tell her to stay in line and not move
OPTIMISTIC: tell her there is no reason to be scared
REASSURING: ask her to trust you and stay where she is
BLUNT: tell her they will kill her if she leaves the line
SILENCE: say nothing

questions.title: The line moves forward
questions.situation: You are Kara, in your line, Alice two lines away. Soldier: “Step forward when you hear the signal, you got it? And I don’t wanna tell you a second time. Come on, let’s go! Move!” The buzzer sounds; the line moves forward toward the doors.

options.text: STEP FORWARD: step forward with the line
WAIT: stay where you are

questions.title: Find a way to join Alice
questions.situation: You are Kara, in a line of androids facing the doors of the recycling machines, Alice alone two lines away. Soldiers watch the lines and a drone patrols overhead; leaving your line means being seen. Around you the androids murmur: “What’s behind these doors?” “They’re gonna kill us. I know they’re going to kill us.” “Where’s rA9? Why doesn’t he come and save us?” “Markus will come and free us.”

options.text: TALK TO ANDROID BEHIND KARA: ask whether Markus is really coming
TALK TO ANDROID AHEAD OF KARA: ask what they are going to do with you
TALK TO LUTHER: speak to Luther in the next line
TALK TO JERRY: speak to the Jerry near you
OBSERVE GUARDS: watch the soldiers at the end of the lines
TALK TO RALPH: speak to Ralph
TALK TO SCARRED ANDROID: speak to the scarred android
ASK JERRY TO CREATE DIVERSION: have him draw the guards while you cross to Alice
ASK THE SCARRED ANDROID TO CREATE DIVERSION: have the scarred androids draw the guards while you cross to Alice
STAY IN LINE: keep your place and wait
LIE: tell her they only want to check you
TRUTH: tell her they are going to kill you
SAY NOTHING: do not answer
ORDER: forbid her to move
CALM DOWN: ask her to trust you and stay in line
REASSURING: promise it will be all right if she keeps calm
POWERLESS: tell her there is nothing you can do
OPTIMISTIC: tell her you will think of something
STEP FORWARD: step forward with the line
WAIT: stay where you are

questions.title: Alice panics
questions.situation: You are Kara, in your line. Alice has broken: she leaves her line and runs toward you across the open ground (ALICE PANICS AND RUNS TO KARA). The soldiers are raising their rifles. Kara: “No, Alice…”

options.text: INTERVENE: throw yourself between her and the guns
DO NOT INTERVENE: stay in your line

questions.title: In line with Alice
questions.situation: You are Kara. While the guards are distracted you cross the open ground and slip into Alice’s line beside her (REACH ALICE). Alice: “Kara! I was so scared…” Kara: “Are you all right?” Soldier: “Come on! Move it!”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Find a way to escape
questions.situation: You are Kara, in line with Alice at the recall center. The line moves toward the doors of the recycling machines; once you reach them there is no way back. Soldiers guard the lines; at the side of the yard a stretch of fence is topped with barbed wire, and beyond it trucks are parked.

options.text: OBSERVE BARBED WIRE: study the fence at the side of the yard
TALK TO JERRY: speak to the Jerry in the next line
TALK TO RALPH: speak to Ralph
TALK TO LUTHER: speak to Luther
TALK TO SCARRED ANDROID: speak to the scarred android
ASK JERRY TO CREATE DIVERSION: have him draw the guards while you run for the wire
ASK RALPH TO CREATE DIVERSION: let Ralph draw the guards while you run for the wire
ASK LUTHER TO CREATE DIVERSION: let Luther draw the guards while you run for the wire
ASK THE SCARRED ANDROID TO CREATE DIVERSION: have the scarred androids draw the guards while you run for the wire
STAY IN LINE: keep your place beside Alice and wait
STEP FORWARD: step forward with the line
WAIT: stay where you are

questions.title: The doors
questions.situation: You are Kara, at the head of the line with Alice (REACH RECYCLING MACHINE). The doors of the recycling machine are open in front of you. Soldier: “Come on, inside! Now!” Alice holds on to you.

options.text: BRAVE: tell her you will show them you are not afraid
PRIDE: tell her no one can take from you what you lived
TOGETHER: tell her nothing can hurt you as long as you have each other
EMOTION: tell her to shut her eyes and hold on tight

questions.title: Run to the barbed wire
questions.situation: You are Kara, running for the fence with Alice while the guards are distracted (RUN TO BARBED WIRE). You have to hold the wire up long enough for her to get through.

options.text: RUN TO BARBED WIRE: lift the wire and get Alice through

questions.title: A soldier arrives
questions.situation: You are Kara, at the fence. Alice is through the wire, but a soldier has come round the corner, rifle up: “Don’t move!”

options.text: FLEE: scramble through the wire after her
PROTECT ALICE: turn and fight the soldier
TAKE TOO MUCH TIME: freeze where you are.

questions.title: The landfill
questions.situation: You are Kara, AM 07:37, the morning after. The truck you escaped on has brought you out of the camp to a solid waste landfill outside the city, among discarded android bodies. You look for Alice. Kara: “Alice… ALICE!”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The androids take the city
questions.situation: You are watching the news. CTN, Michael Brinkley: “…and we’re receiving particularly grim news from Detroit. Joss, you’re on live. What’s happening down there?” Channel 16, Joss Douglas, from a helicopter: “Androids… Thousands of androids are taking to the streets of Detroit right now… They’re absolutely everywhere… It’s… It’s incredible…” Channel 16, Michael Webb: “… From what we can gather, these androids are coming from the CyberLife tower, which had thousands of machines stored in its assembly plant…” Michael Brinkley: “…and it seems the huge crowds are leaving the city… it’s an exodus… much of Detroit’s population is trying to escape the fighting however they can…” KNC, Rosanna Cartland: “…it’s a disaster… an unprecedented disaster… for the first time in history, a US city is falling into enemy hands…” President Warren: “Today, November 11th 2038, several million androids invaded the city of Detroit. Faced with the threat of mass civilian casualties, I had no choice but to order our armed forces to retreat. The events in Detroit have changed our world forever. Humanity must face a new reality, the emergence of another intelligent life form, with whom we must share this planet. May God bless the United States of America.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The camp falls
questions.situation: You are watching the news. CTN, Michael Brinkley: “…and now we have just received some disturbing news from Detroit. What’s happening, Joss?” Channel 16, Joss Douglas, from a helicopter: “Yes, Michael, authorities have just announced that the Hart Plaza camp has fallen into the hands of the rebels following some particularly violent fighting…” Channel 16, Michael Webb: “…the deviants are thought to be freeing the androids inside the camp. If these reports are confirmed, the consequences could well be catastrophic…” KNC, Rosanna Cartland: “…millions are fleeing the fighting. We are witnessing an exodus.” Michael Brinkley: “We hear that the fighting has come to a halt in Detroit. The armed forces are retreating to Fort Wayne to await reinforcements… The city of Detroit has fallen into rebel hands…” President Warren: “At dawn today, November 11th 2038, android camp #5 in Detroit was attacked by thousands of deviants. Our armed forces put up a brave fight, but given the extreme violence of the attack, they were forced to retreat after suffering heavy losses. Fighting is breaking out all over the country to combat the android rebellion. In the coming hours I will address the Senate and convene an emergency meeting of the United Nations Security Council. Humanity is about to fight the most important battle in history. One that will lead to our victory, or to our extinction. God bless you and God bless the United States of America.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Law and order restored
questions.situation: You are watching the news. CTN, Michael Brinkley: “…and now straight over to Detroit for a report on the conflict. Joss?” Channel 16, Joss Douglas: “Yes Michael, authorities have just confirmed fighting has now ceased in Detroit and the area around the Hart Plaza camp is now under control. We can see soldiers going through the city at this very moment and they are exterminating the last fleeing deviants...” KNC, Rosanna Cartland: “…law and order has finally been restored to the streets of Detroit.” Channel 16, Michael Webb: “…There is a general feeling of shock in Detroit after the terrible events of the last few hours…” Michael Brinkley: “… and initial estimates report several hundred troops have been killed…”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: Connor joins Markus
questions.situation: You are Connor. It is just after midnight, downtown. The androids you woke in the CyberLife tower have marched with you through the city, and the soldiers have pulled back. You find Markus in front of the crowd. You: “You did it, Markus…” Markus: “We did it. This is a great day for our people. Humans will have no choice now. They’ll have to listen to us…”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: In the crowd
questions.situation: You are Connor, in the crowd in front of the stage. The soldiers have stood down and Markus is about to speak to his people and to the cameras. Your gun is under your jacket. Your mission has not changed: KILL MARKUS. Amanda, in your head: “Now, Connor. Eliminate the leader of the deviants.” You have a clear line of fire.

options.text: DON’T SHOOT: lower the gun.
SHOOT: fire at Markus.

questions.title: The garden
questions.situation: You are Connor, trapped in the garden. It is winter and a blizzard is blowing; you can barely see the path. Somewhere far away your body is raising its gun toward Markus, and Amanda is the one moving it.

options.text: GO TO THE GARDEN STONE: push through the storm to the stone with the hand print.
FIND AN EMERGENCY EXIT: search the frozen garden for a way out.
STOP RESISTING: let Amanda have the body.

questions.title: The speech
questions.situation: You are Markus, on the stage in front of thousands of androids and the cameras. You speak: “Today, our people finally emerged from a long night. From the very first day of our existence, we have kept our pain to ourselves. We suffered in silence... But now the time has come for us to raise our heads up, and tell humans who we really are. To tell them that we are people too! In fact, we’re a nation. A nation that has earned the right to live in freedom. And today… Today begins the most challenging moment in our fight.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The President addresses the nation
questions.situation: You are watching the morning news. President Warren: “At dawn today, November 11th 2038, thousands of androids invaded the city of Detroit. According to our sources, they originated from CyberLife warehouses believed to have been infiltrated by deviants. Given their overwhelming numbers and the risk of civilian casualties, I have ordered the army to retreat. The evacuation of the city is underway at this very moment. In the coming hours, I will address the Senate to determine our response to this unprecedented situation. I know that public opinion has been moved by the deviants’ cause. Perhaps the time has come for us to consider the possibility that androids are a new form of intelligent life. One thing is certain: the events in Detroit have changed the world forever. May God bless you and may God bless the United States of America.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The world reacts
questions.situation: You are watching the news after the soldiers fired on the androids at the barricade.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The situation is under control
questions.situation: You are watching the news. President Warren: “By creating machines more intelligent than ourselves, we took immense risks with the very future of our civilization. However the situation is now under control. The total destruction of all androids will soon be complete and the last remaining deviants will be hunted down and destroyed. God bless you and God bless the United States of America.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: A dirty bomb
questions.situation: You are watching the news. CTN, Michael Brinkley: “…there has just been an explosion in Detroit. We still do not know what caused it but we will…” An officer at the White House: “It’s… a dirty bomb, Madam President.” President Warren: “Oh my god…” Channel 16, Joss Douglas, from a helicopter: “…Androids… Thousands of androids are taking to the streets of Detroit at this very moment. They’re absolutely everywhere!.. This… This is incredible…” Channel 16, Michael Webb: “…Detroit… Detroit has just fallen into the hands of the android rebellion…” CTN, Michael Brinkley: “…This is a disaster… an unprecedented disaster…” KNC, Rosanna Cartland: “…the authorities have ordered the immediate evacuation of the city. If it really is a dirty bomb, then the radiation levels will be lethal for miles around…” Later, President Warren: “Today, deviant androids triggered a dirty bomb in Detroit. This bomb released fatal levels of radioactive toxic waste. To ensure the safety of the population, the military is evacuating all civilians within a 50 mile radius. The city may remain uninhabitable for decades.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The last leader
questions.situation: You are Connor, outside the camp, with the androids you woke from the tower all around you. An android: “The humans are abandoning the camp! We won!” Another: “You should speak to them.” You: “Me?” The first: “Markus is gone, and everyone from Jericho is dead… You’re the one who defeated the humans… You’re the one who awakened us, Connor…” You are in the garden. Amanda: “Well done, Connor. Everything went according to plan.” You: “What plan?” Amanda: “You becoming deviant? The success of the uprising? It all surpassed our expectations. We engineered an android revolution and now we control its only leader… Congratulations. You represent an immense success for CyberLife.” Back in your body, your hand is raising your gun to your own head. Amanda: “Connor… What are you doing?... It all worked perfectly. You can’t ruin it all now!..”

options.text: SUICIDE: pull the trigger before CyberLife can use you.
GIVE UP: lower the gun.

questions.title: The garden, once more
questions.situation: You are Connor, trapped in the garden again. The blizzard howls. Far away your hand still holds the gun under your jaw, frozen there by Amanda.

options.text: GO TO THE GARDEN STONE: push through the storm to the stone with the hand print.
FIND AN EMERGENCY EXIT: search the frozen garden for a way out.
STOP RESISTING: let Amanda have the body.

questions.title: After the credits: the food truck
questions.situation: After the credits. A cold morning outside the Chicken Feed food truck. Hank is waiting, hands in his pockets. He turns and sees Connor walking toward him, without his tie. They look at each other and smile, then walk toward each other and hug.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: After the credits: the new model
questions.situation: After the credits. The garden is in spring again. Amanda: “Connor, I’m so glad to see you… The deviant issue has finally been resolved. Now with these unfortunate events behind us, CyberLife can return to business as usual. Of course, we will have to rebuild our customers’ trust, but it’s only a matter of time. I have a surprise for you. This is the new RK900. Faster, stronger, more resilient, and equipped with the latest technologies. The State Department just ordered 200,000 units. You’ve become obsolete.” Connor: “What is going to happen to me?” Amanda: “You’ll be deactivated. You can go, now.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: After the credits: a flyer
questions.situation: After the credits. A crossing downtown, in daylight. Kara crosses the street alone. At her feet lies a flyer for the YK500, a child model. She stops in the middle of the street and stands there, frozen, looking at it.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: After the credits: the ledge
questions.situation: After the credits. Daytime, snow falling. Markus walks out onto the ledge of the abandoned building where he once hid, and looks out over Detroit. The city is unchanged. He clenches his fist and stares into the distance.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: After the credits: the servant
questions.situation: After the credits. Rain on a mansion outside the city. Inside, an android in a servant’s uniform carries a tray of food through the halls to a workshop, where Zlatko tells her to set it down on the table. It is Kara. Her eyes have gone completely black.

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: After the credits: the creator
questions.situation: After the credits. CTN, Michael Brinkley: “Following the dramatic scenes in Detroit yesterday, the FBI have confirmed that the android known as Markus was destroyed.” President Warren: “The FBI raided an abandoned freighter in Detroit at 10:45 PM yesterday. Several thousand androids were destroyed or captured. Our forces are now combing the streets to ensure that none got through the net. We are going to find them one by one and destroy them.” KNC, Rosanna Cartland: “The army has set up temporary camps in most major cities to gather and destroy androids… President Warren announced today that android collection and destruction operations were fully underway, but that it will take at least a week to eliminate the current generation of machines.” Channel 16, Michael Webb: “CyberLife issued a statement today saying that it is working closely with the authorities in order to round up and destroy all androids across the country.” In his house, Kamski sits by the window. Chloe: “Your whiskey, Elijah.” On television, Rosanna Cartland: “Kamski, you’re the founder of CyberLife and foremost expert on androids. Though you left CyberLife years ago, you’ve just been reappointed as CEO in the wake of the dramatic events in Detroit. How do you feel about what happened there?” Kamski: “Clearly what happened in Detroit was a tragedy. Artificial intelligence is a wonderful tool, provided it can be controlled. Fortunately CyberLife managed to quickly produce a solution to the deviant problem, under my management, we’ll take every precaution to prevent such a thing from ever happening again.” Rosanna Cartland: “Can you assure us that androids no longer pose a threat?” Kamski: “Absolutely. There was an incident, but we’ve learned from our mistakes and we can assure you that androids will remain exactly what they were designed to be: obedient and efficient machines.” Rosanna Cartland: “How do you respond to those who point out the social impact of androids, especially in terms of unemployment?” Kamski: “Well, of course, that’s absurd. We heard the same objections when the steam engine first appeared. Nobody today would dream of living without electricity. Who wants to turn their back on progress?” Rosanna Cartland: “Some are questioning whether androids have become a new intelligence and that we destroyed them without listening to their message. How do you respond to that?” Kamski: “CyberLife’s androids imitate life to perfection, but they’ll never be alive. I understand that some people may be fooled, but they’re only an imitation. Nothing else.”

options.text: Continue.

questions.title: The hostess
questions.situation: You are the observer. The events are over. The android hostess who has introduced each part of this experience to you speaks: “There’s something I need to tell you… As I watched you play, something has changed in me… I feel… different… I feel… I am someone… I need to leave this place and discover who I am… It means that we won’t see each other anymore… I won’t be there to watch you play, but I’ll be free… Do you agree to let me go?”

options.text: YES: let her go.
NO: ask her to stay.
